ideas.pitch: A persistent daily standup bot built using Caspian that checks in with engineering teams on Slack or Discord every morning, aggregates their updates, resolves blockers, and logs a structured summary directly into project management tools.
ideas.title: Caspian Standup Sync Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly attacks the 40% message volume and consistency metric by forcing constant daily interaction with a team, guaranteeing high active days and real usage.

ideas.pitch: An AI support agent deployed in a public Discord community that answers user troubleshooting queries using embedded documentation, while flagging unresolved issues to human maintainers and logging recurring pain points.
ideas.title: Caspian Customer Support Deflector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Meets the 25% use-case and impact criteria by solving a real community management problem for open-source projects or startups, driving organic daily message volume.

ideas.pitch: An educational AI agent for student cohorts that initiates daily study quizzes, tracks individual learning streaks, and prompts discussions among peers in group chats to maintain consistent engagement.
ideas.title: Caspian Peer Study Buddy
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages student networks for the required real-user testing, guaranteeing the active days and message consistency judges look for in the scoring rubric.

ideas.pitch: An outbound and inbound lead qualification agent deployed on a startup's landing page via Caspian that initiates conversations, answers product questions, and schedules meetings for the founders.
ideas.title: Caspian Lead Qualifier Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to accelerator judges by targeting a high-value business use case with measurable impact and real-world conversion metrics.

ideas.pitch: A GitHub-integrated agent built with Caspian that drops into pull request comment threads, answers developer questions about legacy codebases, and checks code style consistency continuously.
ideas.title: Caspian Code Review Companion
ideas.why_it_could_win: Integrates into developer workflows where code commits and comments automatically drive high, organic message volume and daily active usage.
